repository_state.notes: Phase 1 Foundation is complete (phase_completion_records/P001-completion.md). Phase 3's first increment is implemented: jarvis_core/ai/ (provider abstraction, AnthropicProvider, cost tracking, AIRouter), exposed via POST /ai/complete. 36 automated tests exist and pass (pytest), CI runs them on every push/PR. No real network call to Anthropic has been made in this environment -- no API key is configured here, and none should be committed to the repo; verification is unit-level (injected fake client) plus a build-and-boot smoke test. Phase 3 is not complete: no P003-completion.md yet, no second provider, no real routing logic beyond one configured model, no dedicated security review of this increment specifically.

implemented_features: Layered config system (defaults -> YAML file -> env overrides), validated via Pydantic, with enforced loopback-only service.host (jarvis_core/config)
Structured logging to console + rotating file (jarvis_core/observability)
SQLite storage layer with permission_grants, audit_log, and ai_usage tables (jarvis_core/storage)
Capability-based permission system: deny-by-default store, tier classification, require() enforcement gate with mandatory audit logging (jarvis_core/permissions)
Plugin manifest schema + directory-based discovery with per-plugin failure isolation (jarvis_core/plugins)
Core HTTP service (FastAPI/Uvicorn, loopback-only, enforced) with /health, /status, and /ai/complete endpoints (jarvis_core/service)
CI pipeline running pytest on every push/PR (.github/workflows/ci.yml)
Secret storage wrapper around OS keyring (jarvis_core/secrets.py, D-0012)

AI provider abstraction (jarvis_core/ai/provider.py) and first concrete provider, AnthropicProvider (jarvis_core/ai/anthropic_provider.py, D-0015), with lazy key lookup so Core starts without a key configured
AI cost tracking against a configurable monthly ceiling (jarvis_core/ai/cost.py, D-0016) and AIRouter enforcing permission + ceiling + audit logging before/after every call (jarvis_core/ai/router.py)
verified_features: Config system: 7 automated tests passing (defaults, file override, env override, path resolution, loopback-host enforcement via direct construction/file/env)
Permission system: 10 automated tests passing (deny-by-default, grant/revoke, full-catalog seeding, tier mapping, require() allow/deny paths, audit-log write on both granted and denied checks)
Core service: 5 automated tests passing (/health, /status including ai_router_configured flag, and /ai/complete's 503/403/200 paths)

AI module: 9 automated tests passing (cost tracker accumulation/ceiling math, router permission/ceiling/audit-logging behavior with a fake provider, AnthropicProvider error handling and response parsing with an injected fake client)
Phase 1 completion bar fully met -- see phase_completion_records/P001-completion.md. Phase 3's first increment has tests + verification but not yet a completion record (see known_risks).
blocked_features: Real end-to-end verification of AnthropicProvider against the live Anthropic API -- blocked on the owner configuring a real API key in the OS keyring (jarvis_core/secrets.py, key name 'anthropic_api_key') in a real runtime environment; this sandboxed session has none and should not be given one to commit.
known_risks: Primary device (HP EliteBook 645 G9) has no dedicated GPU, so the local-tier/cloud-tier split (D-0006) is a hard constraint on later phases, not a preference.
No first-party plugins exist yet, so plugin isolation has only been tested against synthetic fixtures, not a real plugin.

Cost-per-token figures in ai.input_cost_per_1k_usd / ai.output_cost_per_1k_usd are sourced from third-party pricing aggregators, not Anthropic's own pricing page, as of D-0016 -- owner should confirm current rates before relying on the ceiling as an exact cap (the enforcement mechanism works regardless of minor figure drift).

Phase 3's first increment has not had a dedicated security review the way Phase 1 did (D-0014) -- audit-log content was deliberately kept to metadata only (no prompt/response text), but a full review of the AI module specifically has not been recorded.

No real network call to the Anthropic API has been exercised anywhere yet -- only unit tests with an injected fake client. The first live call should be treated as a verification step in its own right, not assumed to work from unit tests alone.
Android integration approach remains open, deferred to Phase 7.
next_actions: Owner: configure a real Anthropic API key via the OS keyring (never a config file, env var, or anything committed to the repo) and verify one real end-to-end /ai/complete call.
Decide the next increment: a second provider for real fallback, broader routing logic (task classification / model selection), or a first plugin that actually calls /ai/complete.

Before declaring Phase 3 complete: write phase_completion_records/P003-completion.md once the full roadmap.md completion bar is met for whatever scope Phase 3 is deemed to cover -- a partial increment, however solid, is not 'complete'.
Separately, and not blocking Phase 3: a first trivial first-party plugin would give the Phase 1 plugin loader real exercise.
